title: The Holographic Universe Explained
summary: A PBS Space Time episode explaining the holographic principle: the idea that our 3+1 dimensional universe may be described by information on a lower-dimensional boundary. It walks through black hole entropy and the AdS/CFT correspondence.
why: HN commenters point to it as an accessible way to get a grip on AdS/CFT and the holographic principle whenever black holes or information physics come up.

quote.text: Here's a video that made me feel like I almost half-way understood one of the main underlying principles (AdS/CFT correspondence)
